about_the_game:
"Bisvita!" (tentative name) is a pixel-style life simulation game.

You will start a unique life of studying abroad in a foreign town: taking classes, working part-time, and making friends while slowly exploring your own rhythm of life.

This is a story about growth, independence and choice. There are no tight time limits, no forced goals, only rich daily experiences and a free lifestyle. You can meet all kinds of classmates, experience the collision of different cultures, and even start your own business - everything is up to you.

🌸 Main features

Experience the real life of studying abroad: attending classes, working, socializing, cooking, managing finances, renting a house... From trivial matters to surprises, recreate all aspects of studying abroad.

Freely explore the pixel town: Explore campuses, cafes, parks, bookstores and other places full of life in a 2.5D pixel world.

Interpersonal relationships and emotional growth: Build relationships with classmates, teachers or neighbors. Every choice you make will affect the direction of your story with them.

Self-development system: Improve skills, master new abilities, and unlock more lifestyles through learning and working.

Warm and healing atmosphere: a relaxed-paced life experience, paired with soft pixel art style and soothing music, making every day worth looking forward to.

Integration of Chinese and foreign cultures: Feel the differences in language, food and festivals in the game, and experience the fun of growth and adaptation.

Whether you are a player who misses your school days or a new traveler who yearns for life in a foreign country,

"Bisvita!" will take you to experience a pixel life full of warmth.

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • OS: win7/win10
  • Processor: Intel Core i5-6400 0r AMD FX 8320
  • Memory: 8 GB RAM
  • Graphics: NVIDIA GTX 960 or AMD Radeon R9 280
  • DirectX: Version 11
  • Storage: 4 GB available space
